name: spreadsheetRenameSheet
description: Renames a sheet in a spreadsheet workbook. The sheet is identified by its 1-based sheet number (the first sheet is 1). The fluent member form is renameSheet(sheetName, sheetNumber).

params.name: sheetName
params.description: The new name for the sheet.

params.name: sheetNumber
params.description: 1-based index of the sheet to rename (default 1).

examples.title: Rename the first sheet
examples.description: Rename the default Sheet1 to People.
